title: One fact request: one line of _build/facts/requests.jsonl
description: The queue of facts that a writer needed and the canon did not have. Written only by `facts request`.

question.description: what the fact must answer; the same text as the needs-fact marker

where.description: '<file>#<section id>' (the section id is the heading anchor without the time box) or '<item id>'

fact.description: the fact id that answers the request (filled); for a display request, the existing fact that needs the new display

display.description: display request only (`facts request --fact ID --display TEXT`): the wanted canonical value string

note.description: for unfillable: where the search looked and what the sources do support
